描述_EN: its beauty lies in the simplicity of form, the high quality of the wood, and the meticulous craftsmanship. it is constructed entirely of mortise-and-tenon joints and without the use of nails. this chair is a typical example of furniture made during the ming dynasty (1368-1644). chairs of this kind inspired the 'kinastol' (chinese chair) of 1944 by the danish designer hans wegner.
描述_ZN: 它的美在于简单的形式，高质量的木材，以及细致的工艺。 它完全由榫卯结构构成，没有使用钉子。 这把椅子是明代（1368-1644）家具的一个典型例子。 这种椅子启发了丹麦设计师汉斯-韦格纳1944年的 "中国椅"（Kinastol）。
